name: The perfect surprise
source:
Dory woke up on what he thought was a regular day. But before long, he realized today was actually quite the special day...

"Wait, today is Joly's birthday, isn't it?
And there's so much stuff I need to do..."

However! If Dory was one thing, it was determined.

"But it's okay! If I shower quickly, I should be able to make it all in time!
I just hope I don't encounter Joly anywhere! She's sharp, she'll know what I'm doing...
If I just had some way of going back in time if Joly finds me..."

But unbeknownst to him, as Dory was getting ready a mysterious app got installed on his phone...

Will you be able to help him out prepare the perfect surprise?

[From [url=https://aurum-lingua-games.itch.io/the-perfect-surprise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“多莉在他认为是平常的一天醒来。但不久之后，他发现今天其实是个很特别的日子……

“等等，今天是乔莉的生日，不是吗？
而且我还有很多事情要做……”

然而！如果多莉是一件事，那就是确定的。

“不过没关系！如果我洗得快的话，应该能及时赶到！”
我只是希望我不会在任何地方遇到乔利！她很敏锐，她会知道我在做什么……
如果乔利找到我，我能有办法回到过去就好了……”

但他不知道的是，当多莉准备好时，他的手机上安装了一个神秘的应用程序……

你能帮他准备完美的惊喜吗？

[来自[url=https://aurum-lingua-games.itch.io/the-perfect-surprise]Itch.io[/url]]
